# D-Zero AI

> WhatsApp AI agents for Nigerian businesses. Configure an AI agent for your business, connect your WhatsApp number, and let it handle customer conversations 24/7 — answering questions, sending product info, capturing leads, taking orders, and routing complex cases to a human operator.

D-Zero AI is built specifically for the Nigerian market: pricing in Naira, support for English and Nigerian conversational patterns, anti-ban pacing for WhatsApp Business safety (warmup tiers, business-hours throttling, human-like send delays), and a dashboard for live operators to take over from the AI when needed. Businesses configure the agent with their products, FAQs, knowledge-base documents, and optional webhook tools that call their own backend.

## Plans (NGN)

- **Free** — 2,000 credits/month, 1 agent — for evaluation
- **Basic** — ₦30,000/month, 25,000 credits, 1 agent — small businesses getting started
- **Starter** — ₦50,000/month, 60,000 credits, 1 agent + lead detection + customer memory + ₦1,000/1k credit overage
- **Pro** — ₦85,000/month, 100,000 credits, 2 agents, priority support, automated follow-ups, ₦800/1k credit overage
- **Enterprise** — custom pricing, unlimited credits, multiple agents

Credits cover both AI-generated replies and human operator messages. Per-message cost: text replies = 5 credits, images = 8 credits, voice = 3 credits/second.

## Core capabilities

### Messaging & AI
- 24/7 automated WhatsApp customer service — sub-2-second average response time
- Context-aware multi-turn conversations with persistent per-contact memory across sessions
- Auto-generated conversation summaries for long threads
- Handles unlimited concurrent chats per agent
- Configurable agent personality, response language (English + Nigerian conversational patterns), business hours, and tone
- Voice call support on WhatsApp via ElevenLabs (Pro plan) — natural-sounding AI voice with custom tones and transcripts
- Image & media sharing — agent can send product photos, PDFs, catalogues; receives and understands incoming images
- Voice note transcription — customer voice messages are transcribed and answered like text

### Knowledge & integration
- Knowledge base with RAG — upload PDFs, Word docs, text files; agent retrieves the most relevant chunks per question
- Structured product/services catalogue baked into the system prompt
- Custom webhook tools — connect any REST API (GET/POST), agent decides when to call each tool based on conversation
- Media library — manage product images the agent can send proactively

### Engagement automation
- AI-personalised follow-up campaigns — agent scans stale conversations, drafts unique re-engagement messages per contact, spreads sends over 24h+ with anti-ban pacing; review mode or fully automatic; 7-day cooldown per contact
- Broadcast campaigns to existing WhatsApp contacts — anti-ban paced, pause/resume controls, auto-stop on repeated failures
- Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) ad context — when a customer clicks a Meta ad (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger), the agent already knows which product/offer brought them in and greets them accordingly
- Welcome / out-of-hours messages
- Conversation history sync on link — pulls existing WhatsApp chats into the dashboard on first connect (admin-gated per user)

### Lead & operator workflow
- AI lead detection — every conversation is scanned for buying intent; matches become structured lead cards
- Lead pipeline: New → Contacted → Won / Lost
- Live operator handoff — take over any chat from the dashboard or directly from your phone; AI auto-pauses for that conversation (configurable per agent)
- Message templates / quick replies for operators
- Real-time conversations dashboard with search, filters, and customer profile view

### Multi-tenant & growth
- Multi-agent workspaces — one workspace can run multiple AI agents (each agent = one WhatsApp number) and multiple team members with role-based access
- Embeddable web widget — drop a single script tag on any website, the same AI agent talks to visitors there too; conversations flow into the same dashboard; Shadow DOM isolation so it doesn't conflict with the host site
- Referral program — earn credit-back when businesses you refer subscribe; track referrals and earnings from the dashboard

### Safety & operations
- WhatsApp anti-ban safety engineered in: 4-tier warmup system, human-like send delays, business-hours throttling for non-warmed numbers, automatic backoff on WhatsApp throttle signals, batch breaks every 10 messages
- Conversation analytics — daily/weekly reports, popular question tracking, response time metrics, customer satisfaction scoring
- 30-day rolling billing cycle anchored to subscription start (not calendar month)
- Credit-based pricing covers both AI and human operator messages — predictable cost scaling
- Encrypted at rest for WhatsApp auth state with Supabase Storage backup

## What sets D-Zero apart

- Built for Nigerian businesses first — Naira pricing, local payment integrations, regional conversational patterns
- WhatsApp Business safety engineered in from day one — anti-ban warmup tiers, business-hours throttling, automatic backoff on throttle signals
- Credit-based pricing instead of per-message fees — predictable cost scaling with usage
- Persistent customer memory across conversations, not just within a single thread
- Operator-friendly dashboard: live takeover, message templates, follow-up review, lead pipeline
- AI-personalised follow-ups instead of generic broadcasts to stale contacts
- 30-day rolling billing cycle anchored to subscription start (not calendar month)
- Multi-channel from one AI: WhatsApp + embeddable web widget, same agent, same dashboard
- Referral program with credit-back rewards for growth-aligned customers
